name: instagram_send_dm_image
description: SENDS A REAL MESSAGE TO A REAL PERSON: send an image as a direct message. Returns { recipient_id, message_id }. Instagram fetches the image from the URL, so it must be a public HTTPS URL — a path on this machine cannot be used — PNG or JPEG, 8 MB at most. The same rules as instagram_send_dm hold: only someone who messaged the account first, only inside the 24-hour window from their last message (outside it the API answers error code 10, subcode 2534022), and only a recipient a human allowed with `degen-portal instagram allow <igsid>`. It cannot be unsent through the API. If this fails, read the error and stop.

recipient_id.description: The Instagram-scoped id (IGSID) of the person, from instagram_get_message's `from.id` or instagram_list_conversations. Not a username.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a PNG or JPEG, 8 MB or less. Instagram downloads it, so a local path does not work.
